headline: Public hearing on a third home at 326 Pawtucket Avenue and an electronic message sign at 459 Mineral Spring Avenue.
summary: Ricardo Molina and Deverlyn Gutierrez request a use variance, a frontage variance, and a parking variance for a third dwelling unit. Faria Holdings, LLC requests a special use permit and dimensional variances for an Electronic Messaging Center sign.
items: 326 Pawtucket Avenue, Ricardo Molina and Deverlyn Gutierrez: use variance to add a third dwelling unit in a two-family zone
326 Pawtucket Avenue: frontage variance for 70 feet where 75 feet is required
326 Pawtucket Avenue: parking variance for the proposed development
459 Mineral Spring Avenue, Faria Holdings, LLC: special use permit and dimensional variances for an Electronic Messaging Center sign
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, Pawtucket, RI 02860
plain_text:
City of Pawtucket
Board of Appeals
Meeting Agenda
Monday, November 30, 2026 at 6:45 P.M.
Pawtucket Municipal Annex
100 Freight Street
Pawtucket, RI 02860
Zoning Board of Appeals
1.  PUBLIC INPUT
2.  APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MINUTES
3.  Ricardo Molina and Deverlyn Gutierrez applicants and owners of the property
located at 326 Pawtucket Avenue further identified as Tax Assessor’s Plat 64 Lot 828 and
situated in a Residential Two Family (RT) Zoning District are requesting the following
zoning relief pursuant to the Pawtucket Zoning Ordinance:
1. A Use Variance pursuant to Section 410-12.1(C) to permit the addition of a third
residential dwelling unit on the property, a use prohibited in a Residential Two
Family (RT) Zoning District.
2. A Dimensional Variance pursuant to Section 410-44 (Enumeration) to permit 70
feet of frontage where 75 feet is required.
3. A Dimensional Variance pursuant to Section 410-76(K) concerning the parking
requirements applicable to the proposed development.
  
- FOR PUBLIC
HEARING AND DECISION
4.  Faria Holdings, LLC applicant and owner of the property located at 459 Mineral
Spring Avenue further identified as Tax Assessor’s Plat 46 Lot 733 and situated in a
Commercial General (CG) Zoning District is requesting a Special Use Permit pursuant to
Section 410-88(D)(2) and Section 410-60(W) and Dimensional Variances pursuant to
Section 410-60, Section 410-86 and Section 410-89 of the Pawtucket Zoning Ordinance
in connection with the proposed installation of an Electronic Messaging Center (EMC)
sign.
  
- FOR PUBLIC HEARING AND DECISION
POSTED:  NOVEMBER 5, 2026
                                                       Nathan T. Luciano
                                                       Chairperson
                                                       Board of Appeals
The Pawtucket Municipal Annex is accessible to people with disabilities. Individuals requesting
services of an interpreter for the hearing impaired must notify the City Clerk at 728-0500 (TDD
#722-8239) 72 hours before the meeting date.
